timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: My body hurts right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I’m frustrated with how much this pain gets in the way.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Part of me is angry at my own body.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I’m tired of pushing through this.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels exhausted from carrying this pain.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I wish this would just go away.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels betrayed by my body.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit how hard this has been.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This pain affects more than just my body.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can be frustrated with this pain and still be gentle with myself.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My body isn’t the enemy, even when it hurts.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to fight this pain to get through it.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can make space for discomfort without letting it take everything.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is doing its best with what it has right now.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to rest without feeling like I’m giving up.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can meet this pain with patience instead of anger.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to ask for help and support.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can care for my body exactly as it is today.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of getting through hard days like this.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust my body is trying to heal in its own way.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to move at whatever pace my body needs.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can find small moments of ease, even now.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body deserves patience, not punishment.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m learning to listen instead of override.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can honor what my body is going through.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m more than this pain.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to treat my body like it’s on my side.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
